replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. Math triggers real anxiety for me. The pressure to understand and memorize formulas can feel overwhelming. When I encounter difficult problems, my mind goes blank, and self-doubt creeps in. This stress affects my learning and confidence, making me hesitant to tackle challenging courses or ask for help until the situation becomes unmanageable.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I've started using AI tools recently. It's been helpful in breaking down complex problems into simpler steps I can follow. It's a mixed bag—good for quick answers but not always great for building deep understanding or confidence.
